compute.cost_note: one spaCy tagging pass per file in both corpora; cost scales with total corpus size

do_not_use_when: you have one target document (use bigram_diff)
the corpora differ in register or genre; the diff will mostly measure that
you want an AI/human verdict on either corpus

examples.description: Post-AI vs pre-AI corpus syntactic-template diff

inputs.target: two corpora as directories (--corpus-a-dir/--corpus-b-dir) or file lists (--corpus-a-files/--corpus-b-files)

artifacts: Markdown table of top divergent POS bigrams with examples (stdout or --out)

purpose: Per-bigram POS-bigram diff between two corpora at the aggregate level (per-file mean, pooled, or both). Surfaces the syntactic templates that most separate corpus A from corpus B, for register-level questions such as how an AI-collaborated cohort differs from a pre-AI archive.
use_when: comparing the syntactic-template footprint of two of your own corpora (e.g. post-2022 vs pre-AI)
feeding a corpus-level bigram diff into restoration_packet
